name: Lexington March Mini 2024
information: This competition does not include 3x3 and therefore may not be suitable for newer competitors. Please see [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=kentucky&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) for a list of other upcoming competitions in Kentucky. As space in the venue is limited, you may bring a maximum of one guest.
